## Policy & Featured Writing

**[Public Finance in the Age of AI: A Primer](papers/korinek-lockwood-2025-public-finance-ai.pdf)**\
with [Anton Korinek](https://www.korinek.com/)\
In *[The Economics of Transformative AI](https://www.nber.org/books-and-chapters/economics-transformative-ai)*, NBER Volume, November 2025\
*Featured by [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/research/economic-policy-responses), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/feb/23/ai-how-will-we-be-fed), and [Marginal Revolution](https://marginalrevolution.com/marginalrevolution/2026/02/public-finance-in-the-age-of-ai-a-primer.html)*

*Note: This paper analyzes optimal policy under the assumption of significant labor displacement by AI. It does not constitute a forecast of displacement, nor does it advocate for differentially taxing AI services in today's economy.*
